hero.title: Use a clear headline that states the announcement, perspective, or business update.
hero.description: This template is for authored stories, leadership perspectives, press-style updates, and editorial content that needs a stronger opening section than a standard information page.
hero.panelTitle: Lead with context and business relevance
hero.panelText: State why the update matters, who it affects, and what action or perspective the reader should take away.

text.text:
Open the article with a short summary that establishes the topic, the audience, and the reason this update is important now.

Then structure the body for clarity: background, key details, supporting evidence, and a closing section that points readers to related content or follow-up actions.

This starter content should be replaced during authoring, but it is intentionally informative so editors understand the expected structure before deeper workflow and structured-content integrations are added.
